shared_focus = {
	id = SNS_ud_national_question
	icon = GFX_ac_ud_focus_SNS_ud_national_question
	x = 32
	y = 0
	cost = 5
	available = {
		original_tag = SNS tag = SNS
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		factor = 10
	}
	completion_reward = {
		effect_tooltip = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = ac_up_initialized }
				add_to_variable = { ac_up_sns_continuity = 2 }
				ac_up_bound = yes
				ac_up_recalculate = yes
			}
			country_event = { id = ac_ud_up.1 }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = SNS_ud_national_question_done } }
				set_country_flag = SNS_ud_national_question_done
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = ac_up_initialized }
					add_to_variable = { ac_up_sns_continuity = 2 }
					ac_up_bound = yes
					ac_up_recalculate = yes
				}
				country_event = { id = ac_ud_up.1 }
			}
		}
	}
	search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_POLITICAL }
}

	icon = GFX_ac_ud_focus_SNS_ud_battery_completed
	x = 68
	y = 7
	cost = 10
	prerequisite = {
		focus = SNS_ud_civil_burden_register
	}
	available = {
		original_tag = SNS tag = SNS
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = ac_ud_partners_gate_stonehenge_tt date > 1998.6.18 }
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		factor = 10
	}
	completion_reward = {
		effect_tooltip = {
			add_ideas = SNS_ud_host_of_the_battery_spirit
			country_event = { id = ac_ud_up.11 }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = SNS_ud_battery_completed_done } }
				set_country_flag = SNS_ud_battery_completed_done
				add_ideas = SNS_ud_host_of_the_battery_spirit
				country_event = { id = ac_ud_up.11 }
			}
		}
	}
	search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_POLITICAL FOCUS_FILTER_INDUSTRY }
}

	icon = GFX_ac_ud_focus_SNS_ud_transit_only
	x = 90
	y = 10
	cost = 10
	prerequisite = {
		focus = SNS_ud_refugee_question
	}
	mutually_exclusive = {
		focus = SNS_ud_open_reception_centres
	}
	available = {
		original_tag = SNS tag = SNS
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = ac_ud_partners_gate_refugees_tt date > 2000.4.20 }
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		factor = 5
	}
	completion_reward = {
		effect_tooltip = {
			add_ideas = SNS_ud_transit_corridors_spirit
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = SNS_ud_transit_only_done } }
				set_country_flag = SNS_ud_transit_only_done
				add_ideas = SNS_ud_transit_corridors_spirit
			}
		}
	}
	search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_POLITICAL FOCUS_FILTER_INDUSTRY }
}

	icon = GFX_ac_ud_focus_AMB_ud_republic_contract_ledger
	x = 55
	y = 23
	cost = 10
	prerequisite = {
		focus = AMB_ud_contract_court
	}
	prerequisite = {
		focus = AMB_ud_freight_partnerships
	}
	available = {
		original_tag = AMB tag = AMB
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = ac_ud_partners_gate_postwar_tt ac_ud_partners_postwar = yes }
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		factor = 10
	}
	completion_reward = {
		effect_tooltip = {
			add_stability = 0.02
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = ac_up_initialized }
				add_to_variable = { ac_up_amb_transport = 2 }
				ac_up_bound = yes
				ac_up_recalculate = yes
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = AMB_ud_republic_contract_ledger_done } }
				set_country_flag = AMB_ud_republic_contract_ledger_done
				add_stability = 0.02
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = ac_up_initialized }
					add_to_variable = { ac_up_amb_transport = 2 }
					ac_up_bound = yes
					ac_up_recalculate = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_POLITICAL FOCUS_FILTER_INDUSTRY }
}
